# html_to_markdown v3.8.1 - Table of Contents

> High-performance HTML to Markdown converter

## Modules

- [HtmlToMarkdown](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.md): High-level API for html_to_markdown
- [HtmlToMarkdown.AnnotationKind](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.AnnotationKind.md): The type of an inline text annotation.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.CodeBlockStyle](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.CodeBlockStyle.md): Code block fence style in Markdown output.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.ConversionOptions](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.ConversionOptions.md): Main conversion options for HTML to Markdown conversion.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.ConversionOptionsUpdate](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.ConversionOptionsUpdate.md): Partial update for `ConversionOptions`.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.ConversionResult](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.ConversionResult.md): The primary result of HTML conversion and extraction.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.DocumentMetadata](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.DocumentMetadata.md): Document-level metadata extracted from `<head>` and top-level elements.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.DocumentNode](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.DocumentNode.md): A single node in the document tree.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.DocumentStructure](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.DocumentStructure.md): A structured document tree representing the semantic content of an HTML document.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.GridCell](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.GridCell.md): A single cell in a table grid.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.HeaderMetadata](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.HeaderMetadata.md): Header element metadata with hierarchy tracking.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.HeadingStyle](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.HeadingStyle.md): Heading style options for Markdown output.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.HighlightStyle](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.HighlightStyle.md): Highlight rendering style for `<mark>` elements.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.HtmlMetadata](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.HtmlMetadata.md): Comprehensive metadata extraction result from HTML document.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.ImageDimensions](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.ImageDimensions.md): Image dimensions in pixels.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.ImageMetadata](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.ImageMetadata.md): Image metadata with source and dimensions.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.ImageType](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.ImageType.md): Image source classification for proper handling and processing.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.LinkMetadata](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.LinkMetadata.md): Hyperlink metadata with categorization and attributes.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.LinkStyle](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.LinkStyle.md): Link rendering style in Markdown output.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.LinkType](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.LinkType.md): Link classification based on href value and document context.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.ListIndentType](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.ListIndentType.md): List indentation character type.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.MetadataEntry](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.MetadataEntry.md): A single key-value metadata entry from `<head>` meta tags.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.NewlineStyle](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.NewlineStyle.md): Line break syntax in Markdown output.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.NodeContent](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.NodeContent.md): The semantic content type of a document node.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.NodeContext](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.NodeContext.md): Context information passed to all visitor methods.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.NodeType](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.NodeType.md): Node type enumeration covering all HTML element types.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.OutputFormat](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.OutputFormat.md): Output format for conversion.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.PreprocessingOptions](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.PreprocessingOptions.md): HTML preprocessing options for document cleanup before conversion.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.PreprocessingOptionsUpdate](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.PreprocessingOptionsUpdate.md): Partial update for `PreprocessingOptions`.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.PreprocessingPreset](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.PreprocessingPreset.md): HTML preprocessing aggressiveness level.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.ProcessingWarning](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.ProcessingWarning.md): A non-fatal diagnostic produced during HTML conversion.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.StructuredData](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.StructuredData.md): Structured data block (JSON-LD, Microdata, or `RDFa`).
- [HtmlToMarkdown.StructuredDataType](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.StructuredDataType.md): Structured data format type.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.TableData](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.TableData.md): A top-level extracted table with both structured data and markdown representation.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.TableGrid](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.TableGrid.md): A structured table grid with cell-level data including spans.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.TextAnnotation](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.TextAnnotation.md): A styling or semantic annotation that applies to a byte range within a node's text.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.TextDirection](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.TextDirection.md): Text directionality of document content.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.TierStrategy](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.TierStrategy.md): Controls which conversion tier is used.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.UrlEscapeStyle](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.UrlEscapeStyle.md): URL encoding strategy for link and image destinations.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.VisitResult](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.VisitResult.md): Result of a visitor callback.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.VisitorHandle](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.VisitorHandle.md): Shareable, thread-safe handle to a user-provided HTML visitor implementation.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.WarningKind](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.WarningKind.md): Categories of processing warnings.
- [HtmlToMarkdown.WhitespaceMode](https://html-to-markdown.hexdocs.pm/HtmlToMarkdown.WhitespaceMode.md): Whitespace handling strategy during conversion.
